title: CompliA
line: An AI assistant inside Telefónica's compliance portal: it answers, analyses declarations and helps reach a ruling.

film.alt: Clip of the CompliA demo with sample data.
film.label: Demo · sample data

ten.v: Lots of compliance information and processes that call for judgement: declarations, forms, rulings and reports.
An assistant that searches the documents, answers with that context and stays bounded by rules.
In internal production, inside the portal. A person gives the ruling.

how.d: RAG brings from the documents what each query needs.
Validations review every answer before it is shown.
Restrictions mark which processes go to a person.
It proposes rulings, assigns forms and builds reports.

decisions.why: It writes from what it finds in the documents: every answer rests on a source.
Validations and restrictions act before anything reaches the screen.
In compliance the assistant helps reach a ruling and a person signs it.

more.p: Telefónica's compliance portal digitises declarations and forms. I work on it from Tsoft as a Sr AI Fullstack Developer, end to end.
The steps describe a RAG assistant like CompliA; the demo uses sample data.
